entries.title: Live Spectrogram Alignment
entries.body: Drag-and-drop waveform timing adjustments directly onto phonetic events within the Timeline panel. Visually tune your timings against the actual source audio.

entries.title: Sync Keybinding Performance
entries.body: Greatly reduced UI freezing issues related to the `undoableLyricLinesAtom` memory stack overcommits by isolating history snapshots from real-time events.

entries.title: Genius Songwriter Fetcher
entries.body: Integrated tool in the metadata editor to automatically fetch songwriting credits using the Genius API.
